units: <cite ref="Taanit 22b:19">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>לא שכורה ולא צ׳</he> that the ground be neither drunk (oversated) nor thirsty; a. e.—Pl. <he>צְמֵאִים</he>, <he>צְמֵאִין</he>; <he>צְמֵאוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 19</cite> <he>משקה צ׳ הייתי</he> I used to give drink to the thirsty; <he>והם אומרים לו זה השער לה׳ משקה צ׳ הכנס בו</he> ed. Bub. and they (in heaven) say to him, ‘this is the gate of the Lord’, thou, who hast been a giver of drink to the thirsty, enter thereby.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>וכשצ׳ כל החיות וכ׳</he> and when they are thirsty, all the beasts gather around her (the hind) &c.; a. e.
